result:
The decisions playground now lives at `/ml-inference/playground`. Nothing was run — no tests, no typecheck, no build. The change was already in the working tree when I started, so I only checked it and made no edits.

Both places that define the route were already updated:
- **`products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`:** the `routes` key and the `urls.decisionPlayground()` builder now use `/ml-inference/playground`.
- **`frontend/src/products.tsx`:** this is the aggregated copy of the manifest, and it carries the same two changes.

The route still maps to `['DecisionPlayground', 'decisionPlayground']`, so the same scene opens with the same content and behavior.

A repo-wide grep finds no remaining `ml-inference/decisions` strings. Any menu or in-app link that goes through `urls.decisionPlayground()` picks up the new path automatically, and I found no hard-coded links.

I left the `ml-inference-decisions` feature flag alone. It is a flag name, not a web address, and the backend checks the same flag.

I didn't add a test. This is only a path change, and no existing test refers to the path.

`products.tsx` is generated from the manifests. I didn't regenerate it, so run the products build step to confirm it produces the same file.
